subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Should #99241 remain the canonical tracker for model-visible tool-result placeholder loss, or should maintainers fold it into the older broader #96857 tracker after #99756 is decided?
rationale: Two open high-signal threads overlap: #96857 has the older deterministic aggregate root cause, while #99241 has newer WebChat/model-visible evidence and active linked PRs; choosing the canonical tracker is a maintainer coordination decision, not a code inference.

options.title: Keep #99241 Canonical Until #99756 Resolves
options.body: Use #99241 as the active user-facing tracker for the model-visible payload invariant, then reconcile it with #96857 after #99756 lands or is rejected.

options.title: Fold Into #96857 Now
options.body: Close #99241 as a duplicate only if maintainers decide the older aggregate-truncation thread should own every remaining placeholder report.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Keep both issues open but explicitly scope #96857 to aggregate truncation and #99241 to provider/payload projection until live proof separates them.

recommendation.title: Keep #99241 Canonical Until #99756 Resolves
recommendation.body: Use #99241 as the active user-facing tracker for the model-visible payload invariant, then reconcile it with #96857 after #99756 lands or is rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the main provider replay fix and are the strongest available routing owner for deciding whether the provider-side remaining work stays under #99241 or #96857.
